name: ibis budget Singapore Emerald
short_description: A 2-star, 126-room budget hotel on Lorong 6 Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT and 10 minutes' drive from the CBD.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Emerald sits at 20 Lorong 6 Geylang, on the city fringe near the Singapore Sports Hub, about a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT Station and the National Stadium, and roughly a 10-minute drive from the Central Business District (15 minutes to Orchard Road). The economy hotel has around 126 compact rooms across five room types (12-15 sqm), free WiFi, and free parking, but no on-site restaurant. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.2/5 guest rating from 29 reviews, describing clean rooms and helpful, pleasant staff, while TripAdvisor's larger 146-review sample rates it 3/5, with a minority of guests noting street or room noise. A confirmed May 2025 YouTube room tour corroborates the small-but-clean, budget-tier layout. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits.

elite_benefits: ALL - Accor Live Limitless members can book member-exclusive rates
core_facts.elite_notes: This property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits, per its official ALL listing; ALL members can still book member rates here, but a stay earns no points and carries no status benefits.

pros: 126 rooms across five room types, about a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT Station and the National Stadium
4.2/5 guest rating from 29 reviews on its own Accor listing, with guests praising clean rooms and helpful staff
About a 10-minute drive to the Central Business District, 15 minutes to Orchard Road
Minutes from Geylang's well-known food scene and the Singapore Sports Hub
Free WiFi and free on-site parking
cons: TripAdvisor's larger 146-review sample rates the hotel 3/5, lower than its own Accor listing
Compact rooms (12-15 sqm), typical of the ibis budget economy tier, with no on-site restaurant
A minority of guest reviews mention noise in the room
Does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme
research_highlights: Accor's own hotel page confirms 126 rooms, a 4.2/5 guest rating from 29 reviews, and non-participation in the ALL loyalty programme
TripAdvisor (ranked roughly #204 of 367 Singapore hotels, 146 reviews, 3/5) largely echoes the value-for-money, clean-rooms, helpful-staff verdict
A confirmed YouTube room tour from creator DESIYATRI, published May 2025, corroborates the small, clean, no-frills room layout and location
research_watchouts: The hotel does not participate in ALL - Accor Live Limitless, so no elite benefits apply despite the Accor/ibis branding

No independently dated blog or press review with fetchable, confirmable content could be found; a 2017 WordPress post about the pre-rebrand 'Fragrance Hotel - Emerald' could not be fetched to verify, so it was excluded rather than cited secondhand
Accor's own 4.2/5 rating and TripAdvisor's 3/5 rating diverge, worth noting as inconsistent across platforms rather than universally strong

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Emerald part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Emerald from Kallang MRT station?
faqs.answer: It's about a 10-minute walk from Kallang MRT Station, which also puts the Singapore National Stadium and Singapore Sports Hub within easy walking distance. The Central Business District is roughly a 10-minute drive away, with Orchard Road about 15 minutes by car.
